questions.q: Which of the following is a measure of central tendency?
questions.explanation: Mean is a measure of central tendency, while the others measure dispersion.

questions.q: What does a correlation coefficient of -1 indicate?
questions.explanation: A correlation coefficient of -1 indicates a perfect negative (inverse) correlation.

questions.q: In hypothesis testing, what is a Type I error?
options: Failing to reject a false null hypothesis
questions.explanation: A Type I error is a false positive: rejecting the null hypothesis when it is actually true.

questions.q: Which distribution is typically used for modeling the number of discrete events over a fixed period?
questions.explanation: The Poisson distribution is used to model count data or the number of events in a fixed interval.
